That made the old `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` path safe (escaped text only). This PR deletes `escapeHtml` and passes `body` straight through. verification.reason: The diff removes `escapeHtml` and assigns `body` directly to `dangerouslySetInnerHTML.__html`, so any HTML/JS in the comment string executes in-page. That is a real stored-XSS regression with no sanitizer; critical severity is appropriate.
